fields.description: Lucide icon name shown on the view avatar (e.g. rocket). Blank falls back to a folder.
fields.label: Icon

fields.description: Avatar tint. Blank derives a stable color from the view id.

fields.description: Generated DiceBear avatar, stored as a data:image/svg+xml URI. Set means it is shown instead of the icon. Rendered only as an source, never as markup.
fields.label: Avatar

fields.description: DiceBear style id the avatar was generated from (e.g. notionists).
fields.label: Avatar Style

fields.description: Seed the avatar was generated from. Same style, seed and options always give the same SVG.
fields.label: Avatar Seed

fields.description: JSON object of hand-picked component variants, e.g. {"hair": "variant07"}. Blank leaves every component to the seed.
fields.label: Avatar Options
